class.name: CgameMeshlets
class.brief_description: Splits triangle meshes into small clusters (meshlets) and culls them.
class.description: [CgameMeshlets] is a building block for virtualized geometry. It splits an indexed triangle mesh into meshlets of bounded size using meshoptimizer, and computes for each meshlet a bounding sphere and a normal cone for culling. All methods are static; the class is never instantiated. Each meshlet is a [Dictionary] with the keys: - [code]indices[/code] ([PackedInt32Array]): triangle list, local indices into [code]vertex_ids[/code]. - [code]vertex_ids[/code] ([PackedInt32Array]): indices into the source vertex array. - [code]bounds_center[/code] ([Vector3]) and [code]bounds_radius[/code] ([float]): a sphere containing every meshlet vertex. - [code]cone_axis[/code] ([Vector3]) and [code]cone_cutoff[/code] ([float]): normal cone. A cutoff of [code]1.0[/code] means the meshlet is never cone-culled. Triangle winding follows Godot's convention (front faces are clockwise), so [code]cone_axis[/code] points along the outward geometric normal. [codeblock] var meshlets = CgameMeshlets.build_meshlets(vertices, indices) for m in meshlets: if CgameMeshlets.cone_cull(m, camera_position): continue # Every triangle faces away from the camera. [/codeblock]

method.name: build_meshlets
method.description: Builds meshlets from [param vertices] and the triangle list [param indices]. Every triangle ends up in exactly one meshlet, and no meshlet exceeds [param max_vertices] vertices or [param max_triangles] triangles. [param max_vertices] is clamped to [code][3, 255][/code] and [param max_triangles] to [code][1, 512][/code]. Returns an empty array for empty input, and also, with an error message, when an index is negative or out of range.

method.name: cone_cull
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] when every triangle of [param meshlet] faces away from [param camera_pos], so the meshlet can be skipped. The test is conservative and never culls a meshlet that has a front-facing triangle.

method.name: frustum_cull
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] when the bounding sphere of [param meshlet] lies completely outside at least one of [param planes]. The planes use outward normals, as returned by [method Camera3D.get_frustum]: a point is inside when [method Plane.distance_to] is not positive.
